brief:
The next round of Lebanese-Israeli negotiations, mediated by the United States, has been postponed to October, Shehab Wire reported. The talks were originally scheduled for next week in Rome but will now take place later in the fall.

The delay marks a setback to diplomatic momentum between Lebanon and Israel as they work toward a settlement. The postponement comes amid broader regional tensions and ongoing disputes over maritime boundaries and other contentious issues between the neighboring countries.
